```artifact
@startuml
actor Patient
actor Doctor
actor Chemist
participant "Patient History File" as PHF
participant "Patient Appointment File" as PAF
participant "Consultation Request File" as CRF
participant "Batch Program (Appointment)" as BP_A
participant "Batch Program (Prediction)" as BP_P
participant "Machine Learning Algorithm" as MLA
participant "Database" as DB

== TC-001: Patient creates a Consultation Request (Appointment Mode) ==
Patient -> CRF: Create Consultation Request (Symptoms: "Fever", Reports: "Lab Report.pdf", Mode: "Appointment")
CRF -> BP_A: Store Request
BP_A -> DB: Check Date (Next Day)
DB --> BP_A: Date is Next Day
BP_A -> PAF: Create Appointment Entry
PAF --> BP_A: Appointment Entry Created
BP_A --> CRF: Confirm Request Stored
CRF --> Patient: Request Stored

== TC-002: Patient creates a Consultation Request (Offline Mode) ==
Patient -> CRF: Create Consultation Request (Symptoms: "Cough", Reports: "X-Ray.pdf", Mode: "Offline")
CRF -> BP_P: Store Request
BP_P -> MLA: Predict Disease
MLA --> BP_P: Predicted Priority: Medium
BP_P -> CRF: Update Priority
CRF --> Patient: Request Stored

== TC-003: Batch Program (Appointment) runs nightly ==
BP_A -> DB: Check Current Time (Nightly Schedule)
DB --> BP_A: Time is Night
BP_A -> PAF: Purge Existing Appointments
PAF --> BP_A: Appointments Purged
BP_A -> DB: Fetch Consultation Requests for Next 5 Days
DB --> BP_A: Requests Fetched
BP_A -> PAF: Create Appointment Entries
PAF --> BP_A: Appointment Entries Created
BP_A --> DB: Confirm Appointments Created
DB --> BP_A: Confirmation Received

== TC-004: Batch Program (Prediction) runs periodically ==
BP_P -> DB: Check New Consultation Requests
DB --> BP_P: Requests Fetched
BP_P -> MLA: Predict Disease for Requests
MLA --> BP_P: Predicted Priorities
BP_P -> CRF: Update Priorities
CRF --> DB: Priorities Updated
DB --> BP_P: Confirmation Received

== TC-005: Doctor views and responds to Consultation Requests ==
Doctor -> CRF: View Consultation Requests
CRF --> Doctor: Display Requests with Priorities
Doctor -> CRF: Provide Diagnosis and Prescribe Medicines (Request ID: 123)
CRF -> DB: Update Request with Diagnosis and Prescription
DB --> CRF: Confirmation Received
CRF --> Doctor: Request Updated

== TC-006: Chemist views and updates Prescription Status ==
Chemist -> DB: View Open Prescriptions
DB --> Chemist: Display Prescriptions
Chemist -> DB: Update Prescription Status (Request ID: 123, Status: "Delivered")
DB --> Chemist: Status Updated
DB --> Chemist: Confirmation Received

== TC-007: Patient creates a Consultation Request with Missing Symptoms ==
Patient -> CRF: Create Consultation Request (Symptoms: "", Reports: "MRI.pdf", Mode: "Appointment")
CRF --> Patient: Error: Symptoms are required

== TC-008: Patient creates a Consultation Request with Invalid Mode ==
Patient -> CRF: Create Consultation Request (Symptoms: "Headache", Reports: "MRI.pdf", Mode: "Invalid")
CRF --> Patient: Error: Invalid Mode

== TC-009: Batch Program (Appointment) handles Time Zone Boundaries ==
BP_A -> DB: Check Current Time (Nightly Schedule, Time Zone Boundary)
DB --> BP_A: Time is Night
BP_A -> PAF: Purge Existing Appointments
PAF --> BP_A: Appointments Purged
BP_A -> DB: Fetch Consultation Requests for Next 5 Days
DB --> BP_A: Requests Fetched
BP_A -> PAF: Create Appointment Entries
PAF --> BP_A: Appointment Entries Created
BP_A --> DB: Confirm Appointments Created
DB --> BP_A: Confirmation Received

== TC-010: Batch Program (Appointment) handles Same Day Appointments ==
BP_A -> DB: Check Date (Same Day)
DB --> BP_A: Date is Same Day
BP_A --> CRF: Skip Appointment Creation
CRF --> BP_A: Confirmation Received
@enduml
```
